title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling as long as possible.
body:
We decided to build the opposite. At Headlinne, our goal isn't to hold your attention hostage. It is to give you your time back while keeping you informed.

The problem with modern news isn't a lack of information. It is the noise. Algorithms are often tuned to prioritize outrage and speed over substance. This leaves us feeling overwhelmed instead of knowledgeable.

We use AI to filter that noise. The philosophy is simple. We want to show you the stories that actually matter to your life and your interests without the fluff. We strip away the clickbait headlines and the repetitive updates that clog up your feed.

Technology should serve the reader, not the advertiser. By focusing on clarity and context, we are trying to make the daily news habit feel less like a chore and more like a tool for understanding the world.
cta: You can experience a calmer way to stay informed at HEADLINNE.com.
